recalled_knowledge.item: Bonferroni p_global <= M p_local and Sidak p_global = 1 - (1 - p_local)^M
Gross-Vitells 1D: P(max Z > c) ~ Phi_bar(c) + E[N_up(c0)] exp(-(c^2 - c0^2)/2)
Gross-Vitells 2D: E[Euler characteristic of excursion set] = Phi_bar(c) + (N1 + N2 c) exp(-c^2/2) for a Gaussian field in two parameters
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Vitells & Gross, Astropart. Phys. 35, 230 (2011); Adler-Taylor Gaussian kinematic formula

recalled_knowledge.item: Galwey M_eff = (sum sqrt(lambda))^2 / sum lambda; Gao et al. 99.5%-variance component count
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Galwey, Genet. Epidemiol. 33, 559 (2009); Gao, Starmer, Martin, Genet. Epidemiol. 32, 361 (2008)

recalled_knowledge.item: Sellke-Bayarri-Berger bound B <= -1/(e p ln p)
Light-mediator propagator factor on the differential rate: [m_med^2/(m_med^2 + q^2)]^2 with q^2 = 2 m_N E_R

failed_or_abandoned: First full run with float64 eigenvalue intermediates and six 50k x 654 toy matrices resident died silently (pipeline exit status masked by grep); fixed by releasing calibration matrices and using float32, and by capturing python's exit status

Raw N_eff above 3.4 sigma from 50k-toy calibration (18 at 4 sigma) initially plotted as a rising LEE cost; identified as finite-calibration bias (minimum over noisy per-model thresholds) and replaced by the disjoint-sub-sample extrapolation to N_cal -> infinity; the 5e4-toy cap prevents the direct remedy
Nyholt-Cheverud and Gao eigenvalue estimators (303-444 of 456): uninformative for near-degenerate, zero-inflated statistics; kept only as a warning
Gross-Vitells Euler-characteristic fit on the coarse 3 x 8 (m, delta) grids is unreliable at c0 <= 1 (one blob per grid); fit driven by c0 = 1.5-2.0
The debiasing extrapolation was not computed at local 3.6 sigma (only 2.0-3.4); the corpus value at P021's 3.6 sigma is quoted raw (2.62 sigma, bias ~ +8% in N_eff)
